369|    ANSI art, but you can do so with `ansi2img`_ or `escapes.js`_.

372|    .. _ansi2img: http://www.bedroomlan.org/projects/ansi2img
373|    .. _escapes.js: https://github.com/atdt/escapes.js

376|    nansi, keep, i, text_len = [], True, 0, len(text)

379|            keep = True

# Durable Test Collateral

pin), when the work is a throwaway prototype or a standalone one-file script or
